paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on BioGPT.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and the ACC (%) metric for different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10³, with tick labels at 10⁰, 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 55, with tick labels at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 55. 

The black line, representing “Base”, is a solid line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 28% at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and ends at approximately 31% at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The brown line, representing “MEND”, is a solid line with diamond markers; it begins at approximately 35% at 10⁰ and increases to approximately 44% at 10³. The blue line, representing “FT”, is a solid line with triangular markers; it starts at approximately 33% at 10⁰ and reaches approximately 40% at 10³. The red line, representing “IKE”, is a solid line with triangular markers; it begins at approximately 32% at 10⁰ and ends at approximately 41% at 10³. The green line, representing “ROME”, is a solid line with square markers; it starts at approximately 42% at 10⁰ and rises to approximately 53% at 10³. The purple line, representing “MEMIT”, is a solid line with diamond markers; it begins at approximately 40% at 10⁰ and rises to approximately 48% at 10³.
